thesis: A service-led elevator franchise with 65% ROIC trades below its own 5-year minimum on every multiple at a 6.77% FCF yield, pricing a transitory service-margin squeeze and CEO transition as permanent impairment.
reason: The valuation gap to its own 5-year floor and to peers far exceeds the guided profit cut, and the recurring service base protects the downside. The service-margin squeeze, rising leverage, the CEO transition and a small macro bear tilt cap conviction at 4: 7% core size. This would be the first Industrials holding, and cash covers it.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2021 5-year low of 15.2%, showing the service-margin squeeze is structural, not transitory.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 5-year low of 10.0%, showing cash generation is deteriorating with margins.
Service operating margin (earnings release) falls below 20% for two consecutive quarters, vs 23.2% in Q2 2026, or modernization backlog growth turns negative.

thesis: A deleveraging, 37%-ROIC, 33%-FCF-margin domain and SMB-software franchise trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 13.7% FCF yield, pricing a litigation-driven bookings scare that its reported numbers do not yet show.
reason: Valuation is the cheapest in five years while returns, margins and leverage are all improving; the FCF yield and buybacks give returns without a re-rating. The unproven bookings allegations, rising short interest and Q3 results in three weeks hold conviction at 4, not 5: standard 7% core size. Technology exposure and cash allow it.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% to 37.3%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash-generation gains were promotional or transitory.
Total bookings growth in the SEC 8-K earnings release falls below 4% y/y for two consecutive quarters, showing the promotional-discount allegations reflect a real demand problem.
